newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says investment proposals sharply up in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Manila says investment proposals sharply up in Q1.

text.p: Investment proposals approved by the Philippines' Board of Investments (BOI) rose by 118 percent to 78.9 billion pesos in the first quarter of the year, the BOI said on Thursday.
It approved 36.1 billion pesos worth of proposed projects in the same period last year.
The BOI said it approved 101 projects during the first three months of this year.
Power-related projects comprised the bulk of the approved investments, followed by mining, manufacturing, infrastructure and tourism-oriented projects.
